source: Vanderburg et al. (2020), Nature 585, 363, Methods, transit light-curve fitting (https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.07282)
band: GTC g' band; the coefficients Gianninas et al. (2013) compute from white-dwarf model atmospheres, not a visible-band measurement

u1.fixed: "The Gianninas coefficients (u_1 = 0.05, u_2 = 0.52)", the paper's fixed g'-band values for WD 1856

u2.fixed: "The Gianninas coefficients (u_1 = 0.05, u_2 = 0.52)", the paper's fixed g'-band values for WD 1856

note: The only limb law published for this star: the model coefficients the discovery paper fixed when fitting its transit, which it reports agree with Claret et al. (2019)'s independent u1 = 0.07, u2 = 0.46.
